result.topic_en: Assuming the Riemann Hypothesis and its analogue for $\zeta_1(s)$, Ramanujan gives explicit formulas and asymptotic estimates for $\vartheta_1(x)$ and $\pi_1(x)$, and expresses $2\pi_1(x)$ in terms of $\mathrm{Li}\{2\vartheta_1(x)\}$ and a correction term $R_1(x)$.
result.transcription:
Add ms a 94$^{18(33)}$ (33) 169
54. We shall now assume the Riemann Hypothesis and its analogue for the function $\zeta_1(s)$. Let $\rho_1$ be a complex root of $\zeta_1(s)$. Then it can be shown that
$\sum \frac{1}{\rho_1} = \frac{\gamma - 3\log\pi}{2} + \log 2 + 4\log\Gamma(\tfrac{3}{4})$;
so that
(276) $\sum\frac{1}{\rho} + \sum\frac{1}{\rho_1} = 1 + \gamma - 2\log\pi + 4\log\Gamma(\tfrac34)$.
It can also be shown that
(277) $\begin{cases} 2\vartheta_1(x) = x - 2\sqrt{x} - \sum\frac{x^\rho}{\rho} - \sum\frac{x^{\rho_1}}{\rho_1} + O(x^{\frac13}) \\ 2\pi_1(x) = \mathrm{Li}(x) - \mathrm{Li}(\sqrt{x}) - \sum\mathrm{Li}(x^\rho) - \sum\mathrm{Li}(x^{\rho_1}) + O(x^{\frac13}), \end{cases}$
so that
(278) $\begin{cases} 2\vartheta_1(x) = x + O\sqrt{x}(\log x)^2 \\ 2\pi_1(x) = \mathrm{Li}(x) + O\sqrt{x}\log x. \end{cases}$
Now
$2\pi_1(x) = \mathrm{Li}(x) - \frac{1}{\log x}\left(2\sqrt{x} + \sum\frac{x^\rho}{\rho} + \sum\frac{x^{\rho_1}}{\rho_1}\right)$
$- \frac{1}{(\log x)^2}\left(4\sqrt{x} + \sum\frac{x^\rho}{\rho^2} + \sum\frac{x^{\rho_1}}{\rho_1^2}\right) + O\frac{\sqrt{x}}{(\log x)^3}$.
But by Taylor's Theorem we have
$\mathrm{Li}\{2\vartheta_1(x)\} = \mathrm{Li}(x) - \frac{1}{\log x}\left(2\sqrt{x} + \sum\frac{x^\rho}{\rho} + \sum\frac{x^{\rho_1}}{\rho_1}\right) + O(\log x)^2$.
Hence
(279) $2\pi_1(x) = \mathrm{Li}\{2\vartheta_1(x)\} - 2R_1(x) + O\left\{\frac{\sqrt{x}}{(\log x)^3}\right\}$,
where
$R_1(x) = \frac{1}{(\log x)^2}\left(2\sqrt{x} + \frac12\sum\frac{x^\rho}{\rho^2} + \frac12\sum\frac{x^{\rho_1}}{\rho_1^2}\right)$.
It can easily be shown that
$\sqrt{x}\left(2 + \sum\frac1\rho + \sum\frac{1}{\rho_1}\right) \geq R_1(x)(\log x)^2 \geq \sqrt{x}\left(2 - \sum\frac1\rho - \sum\frac1{\rho_1}\right)$;
